quota_name: Active harvest jobs per channel group
description: The maximum number of concurrent active harvest jobs for each channel group in this account in the current Region.

quota_name: Burst rate of REST API requests
description: The maximum number of REST API requests per second that you can burst to this account in this region.

The maximum number of channel groups that you can create in this account in the current region. This limit doesn't affect channel limits. If you aren't exceeding the channel limit per channel group, you don't need to increase your channel limits when you increase your channel groups.

The maximum number of channels per channel group that you can create. Remember that this is a per channel group limit. This limit doesn't affect origin endpoint limits. If you aren't exceeding the origin endpoint limit per channel, you don't need to increase your origin endpoint limits when you increase your channels.
The maximum number of hours that you can retain ingested content for time-shifted viewing.
The maximum number of streams per channel that you can ingest.
The maximum length of a live manifest, in minutes.

The maximum number of manifests per origin endpoint that you can create. Remember that this is a per origin endpoint limit.  If you have 25 or fewer manifests configured for an origin endpoint, you don't need a manifest limit increase, regardless of how many origin endpoints you have.

The maximum number of origin endpoints per channel that you can create. Remember that this is a per channel limit. If you have 10 or fewer origin endpoints on a channel, you don't need an origin endpoint limit increase, regardless of how many channels you have.

quota_name: Rate of ingest requests per channel
description: The maximum number of ingest requests per second allowed per channel.

quota_name: Rate of manifest egress requests per origin endpoint
description: The maximum number of manifest egress requests per second allowed per origin endpoint.
The maximum number of steady-state REST API requests per second that you can send to this account in this region.

quota_name: Rate of segment egress requests per origin endpoint
description: The maximum number of media segment egress requests per second allowed per origin endpoint.
The maximum length of a time-shifted manifest, in hours, for all supported formats.
The maximum number of tracks (audio, video, subtitle, and so on) per stream that you can ingest.
